title: Sugar Cookie Soda
description: Turns the EXP bottle into a bottle of sugary soda. Includes a recipe.
body:
**Do you have a strange excess of sugar, cookies, and glass bottles?** Are you _tired_ of building EXP farms and trading with villagers for EXP bottles? Need to fill that last little bit of space on your bar to reach level 30 for that enchantment?

Look no further than _Sugar Cookie Soda_ !

This datapack (with texture pack) adds a recipe for a soda that will give you a sugar rush like never before.
